About Me

Building practical, intelligent solutions

I'm an Artificial Intelligence and Data Science student at St. Joseph's Institute of Technology, Chennai, with hands-on experience across Machine Learning, UI/UX design, and cloud-based automation gained through internships and academic projects.

My work so far spans building and evaluating ML models — from regression and classification to CNNs and NLP pipelines — as well as designing user-centric application interfaces in Figma. I've also worked on cloud automation and data engineering, and more recently on early-stage Agentic AI workflows.

I'm currently deepening my understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI — including prompt engineering, RAG, and MCP fundamentals — alongside my existing base in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Cloud Technologies.
